checks_method.description: Same weekday, closest normalized day-of-month per historical month; exclude partial-month analogues >7 days away. September weight 2, August 1. Weighted pooled channel ticket from dated analogues. Frozen channel revenue divided by ticket, rounded to integer checks; implied ticket = frozen revenue / integer checks. Scenarios change transaction volume, not independently identified price. Zero-order analogue ticket fallback: pooled positive same-weekday history. This is conditional decomposition of frozen revenue, not independent traffic forecast.
